QuestInfo.0: #p1082000# is staring out at the sea in #m120041300#. Ask him what's up.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate #b#o3401005##k monsters to create a more pleasant beach. Return to #m120040000# with the #bkeycard#k from #p1082000#.

0.0: Do you see those #o3401005# monsters? It almost looks like a black wave of goo. How can anyone enjoy a beach when a giant black wave of goo is about to swallow them whole? \r\nNow I have to go see Little Richie! Can't you do something?

yes.0: I want you to go out there and do a number on those #b#o3401005##k monsters. You can use the #bGold Beach Entry Pass#k to return to #b#m120040000##k when you're done. I'll be there, nursing my unhappiness.

no.0: I was hoping you would understand the pain I'm going through. At least I don't have to talk to Tofu...

yes.0: I like you! I might let you eat one of my steaks.

mob.0: Did you get rid of 50 #b#o3401005##k monsters in #m120041300#?
